name: Arioch
overview: The Bible presents Arioch in two distinct roles: as king of Ellasar during the time of the early patriarchs (Genesis 14:1, 9) and as captain of King Nebuchadnezzar's guard in Babylon (Daniel 2:14-25). In Genesis, Arioch is part of a coalition of kings involved in regional conflicts, highlighting his political authority. In Daniel, Arioch demonstrates obedience and respect for divine wisdom by promptly bringing Daniel before the king to reveal God's interpretation of the dream, showing his role as an instrument in God's sovereign plan during the exile.
